analysis:
Scope: two CLI files for Darkbloom Sandbox setup. Relevant threat-model entries are TB-013, T-061 and A-019 (installer and add-on run as the Mac owner), plus A-018 and TB-012 (sandbox slots versus inference availability).

Changed behavior:
- In SandboxSetupCommand.swift head lines 142-193, the alreadySetUp path no longer just prints status. When jobsRunning==0 (line 171), it downloads install.sh through the existing withInstaller.
- That download uses the same https-only scriptURL check (head 335-337) and the owner-only staging directory that is removed afterwards (head 346-347).
- It then runs install.sh --plan through requestAddonPlan (head 297-312). This function was not changed and already ran for fresh setups.
- If SandboxSlotChange reports a difference, it offers to apply the change. offer (head 198-220) prompts with a default of yes. Without a prompt (--yes, or stdin is not a TTY), it applies the change only when change.onlyAdds.
- install now takes explicit options (head 351); change.applying(to:) supplies the new counts.
- A failed download in this path prints a hint instead of failing setup (head 342).
- SandboxSetupProgress.swift confirm gains defaultYes. With it, an empty answer counts as yes, and so does EOF, because readLine returning nil becomes "". Only the new slot-change prompt uses this. The fresh-install prompt (head 279) keeps the default of no.

Assessment:
- No new trust boundary. The downloaded installer was already executed as the owner on the setup and rerun paths. TB-013/T-061 already describe setup downloading and running install.sh. The owner explicitly invokes setup, so running --plan on an already set-up Mac widens frequency, not authority.
- Non-interactive auto-apply is limited to slot additions. It is documented in the command help (head 18-20) and never passes --force (head 393-396).
- Slot increases can make inference pause more often under the add-on hold (A-018/TB-012). That is an owner-chosen availability tradeoff, not a confidentiality or authorization regression.

Integration notes:
- Verify that SandboxSlotChange.onlyAdds and applying(to:) (not supplied) cannot turn a plan that removes slots into an automatic apply.
- Verify that SandboxInstaller.download and scriptURL are unchanged.

No findings.
